dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Jerusalem Post directly reports that Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said U.S. aircraft used Israeli bases for strikes on Iran in recent weeks and warned Israel remains ready to respond if attacked. JNS, Kurdistan24 and The Cradle reports on the same Channel 14 interview say Katz also acknowledged Washington has not approved Israel’s requested strikes on Iranian energy or power infrastructure. The account is retrospective and conditional, not evidence that direct strikes resumed; the U.S.-Iran pause still held at the 15Z cutoff. The Post also reports at least three drones intercepted near the Jordanian border on Monday and Tuesday were likely launched by Iran-backed Iraqi militias. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Senior U.S. administration officials told Walla, as directly reported by The Jerusalem Post, that the IDF began redeploying in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh when the pilot programme started last week. They described full redeployment as conditional on Hezbollah disarmament and restoration of Lebanese state sovereignty, and said Washington would keep working with both sides. This refreshes the implementation channel, but same-day Nabatieh strikes and southern demolitions prevent a de-escalation reprice. Raw 87; coupled 97
